title: Cairnwood Estate

services.name: Garden House Rentals
services.desc: The Garden House is a charming building with a breath-taking view of the Bryn Athyn Historic District. Due to the generous support from Cairnwood members, patrons of the Cairnwood Galas, and a Glencairn Foundation grant, the Garden House has been lovingly restored. Today, intimate events of 40 guests or less fit comfortably within the space. The rental fee is $750 and includes access to the Garden House for three hours. A $150 security deposit is due at time of reservation and additional event hours are $150 each. Cairnwood Estate was designed by Carrère and Hastings in the Beaux Arts style.
